title: The Figure a Covered Repair Stands At under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Where a claim on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans has been sent to the bench, the figure standing for the repair is read from the work order carrying that claim's reference, raised with the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service. Which figure on that work order stands for the repair turns on whether the bench has finished the work and on whether a ceiling the customer authorised stands on the order.

Where the work order carrying the claim's reference shows no date the bench finished the work and carries a ceiling the customer authorised above zero, the figure standing for the repair is that authorised ceiling. Where the work order shows no date the bench finished the work and carries no authorised ceiling above zero, the figure standing for the repair is the estimate prepared on that work order. In any other case the figure standing for the repair is the labour and the parts charged on that work order, taken together.

## Which figure is read

| The work order carrying the claim's reference | The figure standing for the repair |
|---|---|
| no date the bench finished the work; an authorised ceiling above zero stands on it | that authorised ceiling |
| no date the bench finished the work; no authorised ceiling above zero | the estimate prepared on that work order |
| any other case | the labour and the parts charged on it, taken together |

## Two readings of the same order

A piece is still at the bench, the order carries no date the bench finished the work, and the customer has authorised work to a ceiling of 600.00 USD (a hypothetical input). The figure standing for the repair is 600.00 USD, whatever estimate was prepared earlier.

The same piece is still at the bench with no authorised ceiling standing on the order, and the estimate prepared came to 480.00 USD (a hypothetical input). The figure standing for the repair is 480.00 USD.
